eventConfiguration.description: Listrak Cross Channel Custom Event Configuration (schema + feature access)

event.description: Cross-channel custom event posted to Journey Hub automations (email, SMS, push, web)

create.notes: HTTP 200 is not a per-recipient success receipt; inspect data[].statusCode

webhooks.reason: The Cross Channel REST API does not offer webhook subscription management (create/list/delete). Official surface is eventConfigurations + events only.

eventConfigurationWrite.reason: There is no public REST create/update/delete for Event Configurations; schemas are defined in the Listrak application under Integrations → Integration Management (type Cross Channel).

canonicalSchemaMapping.reason: Event configurations and posted custom events do not map to business@1 Company/Contact/Deal, support@1, or billing@1 objects (ADR-057). No extensions.mapping shipped — UNVALIDATED would invent a fit that does not exist.
